item.title: Businesses curb growth to duck VAT threshold, HMRC data suggests
item.description: HMRC data suggests thousands of UK small businesses are restricting growth to avoid the £90,000 VAT threshold, prompting renewed calls for reform of the tax “cliff edge”. Read more: Businesses curb growth to duck VAT threshold, HMRC data suggests

item.title: Ready-to-build wind farm ‘loses out to speculative projects’
item.description: Scottish Power has warned that “shovel-ready” offshore wind farms capable of contributing to the government’s 2030 clean power target have missed out on subsidy contracts to earlier-stage schemes that may not be built in time, or at all. Read more: Ready-to-build wind farm ‘loses out to speculative projects’

item.title: Investment in Wayve gives UK ‘seat at the table’ in global robotaxi race
item.description: The British Business Bank has invested £25m in Wayve’s $1.5bn funding round, valuing the UK autonomous driving firm at $8.6bn and securing Britain a stake in the global robotaxi race. Read more: Investment in Wayve gives UK ‘seat at the table’ in global robotaxi race

item.title: Complaints about HMRC surge to five-year high as redress payments rise
item.description: Complaints made by taxpayers about HM Revenue & Customs have climbed to their highest level in five years, with the proportion of cases resulting in compensation also reaching a recent peak. Read more: Complaints about HMRC surge to five-year high as redress payments rise

item.title: BrewDog closes all bars for a day amid sale talks as advisers oversee potential deal
item.description: BrewDog has shut all its bars for a day as it moves closer to a potential sale, with advisers AlixPartners overseeing the process after years of losses and restructuring. Read more: BrewDog closes all bars for a day amid sale talks as advisers oversee potential deal

item.title: BrewDog sold to Tilray in £33m rescue deal as 38 bars close and 484 jobs cut
item.description: BrewDog has been sold to US cannabis and brewing group Tilray in a £33m deal, preserving 733 jobs but triggering the closure of 38 bars and 484 redundancies. Read more: BrewDog sold to Tilray in £33m rescue deal as 38 bars close and 484 jobs cut
